content.title: December jobs report, earnings, CES 2026: What to Watch
content.description:
Market Domination Overtime host Jared Blikre previews several of the biggest stories to come next week, including the release of the December jobs report next Friday; earnings results from companies like Constellation Brands (STZ), Albertsons (ACI), Applied Digital (APLD), and Tilray Brands (TLRY); and the start of the 2026 Consumer Electronics Show (CES) on Monday with keynotes from Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) CEO Lisa Su.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.

content.title: 3 Small-Cap Stocks We Think Twice About
content.summary: Small-cap stocks can be incredibly lucrative investments because their lack of analyst coverage leads to frequent mispricings. However, these businesses (and their stock prices) often stay small because their subscale operations make it harder to expand their competitive moats.

content.title: 1 Profitable Stock on Our Buy List and 2 We Ignore
content.summary: While profitability is essential, it doesn’t guarantee long-term success. Some companies that rest on their margins will lose ground as competition intensifies - as Jeff Bezos said, "Your margin is my opportunity".

content.title: 3 Cash-Producing Stocks We Find Risky
content.summary: Generating cash is essential for any business, but not all cash-rich companies are great investments. Some produce plenty of cash but fail to allocate it effectively, leading to missed opportunities.
